Class PositionId

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.account.position.PositionId
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PositionId extends Object implements Serializable
Represents the composite primary key for a trading position, consisting of an account ID and an instrument ID.
